Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Off Calendar May-20-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Jeffrey A. Dito, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Peninsula Builders, Inc.
Jeffrey Schoffner, President of Pennisula Builders, Inc., was placed under oath and testified.
No appearance by defendant Jet Project Management, Inc., a New York Corporation, doing business as JPM.
Amended Default entered against defendant on February 27, 2008.
Doe defendants dismissed on March 11, 2008.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff Peninsula Builders, Inc., and against the Defaulted Defendant: Jet Project Management, Inc., a New York Corporation, doing business as JPM as follows:

Damages/Principal - $84,351.37.
Prejudgment Interest - $18,288.22.
Costs $388.00, for a total of $103,027.59.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
